Garden Feelings invites visitors to share how a place makes them feel. Choose an emotion, then optionally scan the QR code to explain why.

Student concept for the University of Bristol Botanic Garden. Not an official garden service. Responses are stored only in the browser used to submit them. The colourful starter balls are demonstration content, not visitor data.
